mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned development project ~3.5 hr drive from Perth, close to the regional hub of Katanning, with existing roads and infrastructure. Open-pit mining and industry-standard processing (3.6 Mtpa plant) over +10-yr life; deposits include Jinkas, Jackson, Olympia. Permitting advanced: selected for WA Government Priority Approvals Program; WA EPA assessing at level of Assessment on Referral Information incl. public review; EPBC referral submitted Jul 2025 (27 documents). Freehold land acquisition progressing (240 ha acquired Jan 2026; workforce accommodation facility lease agreed with Shire of Katanning). 44,000 m aggressive exploration drilling underway targeting mine-life extension (Jinkas/Jackson/Olympia hold ~286 koz Inferred within open-pit shell not in Reserve). Initial production targeted late CY2027. On 17 Aug 2026 OceanaGold announced acquisition of Ausgold (+32% share price). [production_notes: No production - development stage. DFS plan: avg 143 kozpa first 4 years, LOM avg 121 kozpa, 1.22 Moz LOM production at 90.4% recovery.
